title: Sodda kasrlarga ajratib integrallash: 1-to‘plam (15 savol)
description: Maxrajni ko‘paytuvchilarga ajratish, sodda kasrlar va koeffitsiyentlarni topish. 1–5 oson, 6–10 o‘rtacha, 11–15 murakkab. Har savolda 4 variant va izoh.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^3 + 1)(x + 2)}
Integral ostidagi kasr qanday sodda kasrlarga ajraladi?
questions.explanation: x^3 + 1 = (x + 1)(x^2 − x + 1) (yig‘indi kubi formulasi). x^2 − x + 1 ning diskriminanti manfiy — u ajralmaydi, shuning uchun suratiga Cx + D yoziladi.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^3 − 8)(x − 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 1∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x − 1 ning koeffitsiyenti — qolgan maxrajning x = 1 dagi qiymatiga teskari son: {1|1^3 − 8} = −{1|7}. (x^3 − 8 = (x − 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4).)

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^4 − 16)(x + 3)}
Javobdagi ln∣x + 3∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x = −3 da qolgan ko‘paytuvchi: (−3)^4 − 16 = 81 − 16 = 65, demak koeffitsiyent {1|65}.
To‘liq kvadratgacha to‘ldiramiz: x^4 + 4 = (x^2 + 2)^2 − 4x^2 = (x^2 + 2 − 2x)(x^2 + 2 + 2x) (Sofi Jermen ayniyati). Ikkala kvadrat uchhadning diskriminanti manfiy.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^5 + 32)(x + 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x + 1∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^5 − 1)(x + 2)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 1∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^4 − 5x^2 + 4)(x − 3)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 3∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?

∫ {dx|(x^4 + x^2)(x + 1)}
Integral ostidagi kasr qanday sodda kasrlarga ajraladi?
questions.explanation: x^4 + x^2 = x^2(x^2 + 1). x ikki karrali: {A|x} + {B|x^2} ikkalasi ham kerak; x^2 + 1 ajralmaydi — suratiga Dx + E.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^3 + 8)(x^2 − 1)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 1∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x^2 − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1). x = 1 da qolgan ko‘paytuvchilar: (1 + 8)(1 + 1) = 18, demak {1|18}.
x^6 − 64 = (x^3 − 8)(x^3 + 8) = (x − 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4)(x + 2)(x^2 − 2x + 4). Yana (x + 2) ko‘paytuvchi bor, shuning uchun (x + 2)^2 — sodda kasrlarda {B|x + 2} va {C|(x + 2)^2} kerak bo‘ladi.

questions.text:
∫ {dx|(x^5 + 2^5)(x^2 − 4)}
Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: x = 2 da qolgan ko‘paytuvchilar: (2^5 + 32)(2 + 2) = 64·4 = 256, demak {1|256}. (x + 2 esa ikki karrali: x^5 + 32 ham x + 2 ga bo‘linadi.)

Javobdagi ln∣x − 2∣ oldidagi koeffitsiyent nechaga teng?
